command: python bench/run.py --gpu 0 --rounds 1 --traces bench/traces/decode_b1.jsonl bench/traces/decode_b8.jsonl --max-batch 32 --max-step-tokens 2048 --corpus judge/prompts/v1.jsonl --name release-smoke-qwen3-30b-a3b-nvfp4 --model nvidia/Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4@2538ded2a4ed --backends holon sglang_http freetoken_http
method: In-process engines driven by bench/driver.py, one scheduling step per call; client-side timestamps taken when a step returns a token. TTFT = first token - release (arrival, or previous turn's last token + gap); TPOT = (last - first) / (tokens - 1) per request; throughput = output tokens / (last token - first release). Decode steps = steps at peak batch that return no first token; decode tok/s = their tokens / their wall time. CPU ms/step = time.process_time() delta around step() on those steps, measured with --blocking-sync (CUDA primary context in blocking-sync mode and torch events created blocking, so waiting for the GPU sleeps and is not counted). Greedy, ignore_eos, fixed output lengths; warmup on the same shapes with other prompt tokens, excluded. HTTP backends (llamaserver, holon_http; bench/backends/http.py): streamed requests, a token timestamped when its chunk arrives; their 'steps' are client polls, so decode tok/s and CPU ms/step do not apply to them.

matched.samplers: top_k / top_p / min_p off on every engine
